# Shrikanteshwar Reddy Pasham
Shrikanteshwar Reddy Pasham is a Hyderabad-based student-entrepreneur, Founder of Reddy Experts™, a digital marketing and tech solutions agency.

## Hero Section
Available for New Opportunities

Building scalable, tech-driven solutions across digital marketing, automation, and technology ventures. Founder of Reddy Experts™, based in Hyderabad, India.
"I build first, polish later."

## About Me
Bridging Engineering, Technology, and Business
I'm a civil engineering student at RGUKT Basar and a student-entrepreneur based in Hyderabad, Telangana. I work at the intersection of technology, systems, and business — building practical, scalable solutions rather than academic-only projects.

Currently, I run Reddy Experts™, a digital marketing and tech solutions agency I founded in June 2026. Previously, I founded Canies Academy™, an edtech venture that is temporarily closed as I focus on scaling Reddy Experts. My work spans web systems, cloud-based automation, AI-assisted workflows, and early-stage product development.

- Execution First: I focus on breaking complex problems into deployable solutions using technology, data, and structured decision-making.
- Scalable Systems: I believe real impact comes from building systems that scale, not just learning tools or collecting certificates.
- Venture Design: Driven by curiosity and experimentation to create product-based businesses that solve real-world problems.

## Professional History
- Reddy Experts™ — Founder (June 2026–Present). Founded a full-service digital marketing and tech solutions agency based in Hyderabad. Offering digital marketing, web/app development, branding, and automation services. Scaling client acquisition and building productized service offerings.
- Canies Academy™ — Founder & CEO (2023–2026, Temporarily Closed). Founded and scaled an edtech venture training school students in emerging tech (AI, IoT, cybersecurity). Built an industry-integrated talent pipeline for tech skills. Designed digital learning architectures and automation workflows. Operations paused as focus shifted to Reddy Experts.
- Synergy Reddy Group™ — Co-Founder, CEO & Chief Architect (2023–Present). Worked with 5+ startups on automation, scaling, and product strategy. Ran Tech Olympiad 2025 and TechSpark 2025 nationwide student events. Building large-scale, product-based ventures through innovation.
- Black Box — Director (2023–2024). Directed a campus-based smart snacks store with 5-minute delivery. Impacted 5,000+ students' lives via late-night campus logistics. Managed end-to-end rapid food distribution.
